criteria.requirement: Add public bar_handle.snapshot() returning frozen ProgressSnapshot(count,processed,total,percent,elapsed,rate,manual,active). Read actual current counters and last sampled raw elapsed/rate values without formatting strings, flushing, updating smoothing/timers or rendering. Unknown totals use None and percent None unless manual mode; preserve skipped count vs processed distinction. Snapshots are independent immutable values, work during pause and after finish, and active reflects actual live handle state. Preserve all old handle controls, manual/unknown modes and receipts.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
